abstract: This book is a primer for engineers and scientists on patents. This 112-page collection is an enlarged version of the June 1979 spec i a l issue of the IEEE/PCS TRANSACTIONS. The 1979 issue was widely used in both industry and the legal profession to take the mystique out of patenting and to educate and encourage would-be inventors. The new edition includes new a r t i c l e s on patenting manmade and how to protect against and cope with patent infringement, with an update on Supreme Court decisions about inventions involving software. It is written in a clear and concise manner that is comprehensive and well understood.

articleTitle: A report on IEEE Workshop on Applied Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: IEEE Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing Newsletter
abstract: The IEEE Workshop on Applied Time Series Analysis, which was jointly organized and cochaired by Professor C.H. Chen, Southeastern Massachusetts University and Professor H.-W. Schuessler, University of Erlangen, was held October 22-23, 1983 at the Institut fur Netzwerktheorie and Schaltungstechnik, TUM in Munich, F.R. Germany. The Workshop was concerned with both theoretical and practical issues of applied time series analysis including the topics on segmentation of time series, array processing, nonstationary time series and applications to radar, geophysical, speech and biomedical signals. The papers presented are briefly summarized and reviewed.
